nodes.label: Deployment Guide
nodes.rationale: Documents dev and prod startup procedures. Dev uses docker compose up; prod uses docker-compose.prod.yml with alembic upgrade head. Required secrets: SECRET_KEY, INITIAL_ADMIN_PASSWORD, POSTGRES_* creds. Production startup validation refuses to start if guards fail.

nodes.label: Infrastructure: Docker + PostgreSQL 16 + Redis
nodes.rationale: Docker Compose for dev and prod. PostgreSQL 16 as primary DB, Redis for JWT JTI blocklist and brute-force rate limiting.
